async def _room_publish(room: str, message: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    if redis_client:
        await redis_client.publish(f"lantern:room:{room}", json.dumps(message, separators=(",", ":")))
        return
    peers = local_room_peers.get(room, {})
    target = message.get("target")
    for route_id, ws in list(peers.items()):
        peer_id = route_id.split(":", 1)[1] if route_id.startswith("host:") else route_id
        if peer_id == message.get("sender"):
            continue
        if target not in (None, "*", peer_id):
            continue
        try:
            await ws.send_json(message)
        except Exception:
            pass


async def _host_online(room: str) -> bool:
    if redis_client:
        return bool(await redis_client.get(f"lantern:room:{room}:host"))
    return any(pid.startswith("host:") for pid in local_room_peers.get(room, {}))


@app.get("/api/config")
async def api_config():
    redis_ok = await redis_available() if MODE == "public" and REDIS_URL else False
    return {
        "mode": MODE,
        "public_origin": os.environ.get("LANTERN_PUBLIC_ORIGIN", "https://dnd.waylonwalker.com"),
        "companion_origin": os.environ.get("LANTERN_COMPANION_ORIGIN", "http://127.0.0.1:8765"),
        "signaling": MODE == "public",
        "signaling_healthy": (redis_ok if REDIS_URL else True),
        "multi_replica": bool(REDIS_URL and redis_ok),
        "draining": draining,
    }


@app.get("/api/qr.svg")
async def api_qr_svg(text: str):
    if not text or len(text) > 1024:
        raise HTTPException(400, "invalid QR payload")
    image = qrcode.make(text, image_factory=qrcode.image.svg.SvgPathImage, box_size=7, border=2)
    import io
    buf = io.BytesIO()
    image.save(buf)
    return Response(buf.getvalue(), media_type="image/svg+xml", headers={"Cache-Control": "no-store"})


@app.get("/favicon.ico")
async def favicon():
    icon = ASSETS / "icons" / "game" / "dungeon-gate.svg"
    if icon.exists():
        return FileResponse(icon, media_type="image/svg+xml", headers={"Cache-Control": "public, max-age=86400"})
    return Response(status_code=204)


@app.get("/download/companion.py")
async def download_companion():
    return FileResponse(Path(__file__).resolve(), media_type="text/x-python", filename="lantern_table_companion.py")


@app.get("/api/ice")
async def api_ice():
    now = time.time()
    if turn_cache.get("iceServers") and now < float(turn_cache.get("expires", 0)) - 120:
        return {"iceServers": turn_cache["iceServers"], "source": "cloudflare-turn-cache"}
    key_id = os.environ.get("CLOUDFLARE_TURN_KEY_ID")
    api_token = os.environ.get("CLOUDFLARE_TURN_API_TOKEN")
    if key_id and api_token:
        url = f"https://rtc.live.cloudflare.com/v1/turn/keys/{key_id}/credentials/generate-ice-servers"
        try:
            async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=15) as client:
                r = await client.post(url, headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {api_token}", "Content-Type": "application/json"}, json={"ttl": 86400})
            if not r.is_error:
                servers = r.json().get("iceServers") or []
                turn_cache.update({"iceServers": servers, "expires": now + 86400})
                return {"iceServers": servers, "source": "cloudflare-turn"}
        except Exception:
            pass
    return {"iceServers": [{"urls": ["stun:stun.cloudflare.com:3478"]}], "source": "cloudflare-stun"}


@app.post("/internal/drain")
async def internal_drain(request: Request):
    global draining
    client = request.client.host if request.client else ""
    if client not in {"127.0.0.1", "::1"}:
        raise HTTPException(403, "loopback only")
    draining = True
    # Broadcast to known Redis rooms via a short-lived drain channel. Clients silently reconnect.
    if redis_client:
        await redis_client.publish("lantern:drain", json.dumps({"type": "server_draining", "retry_after_ms": 400}))
    else:
        for room in list(local_room_peers):
            await _room_publish(room, {"type": "server_draining", "sender": "server", "target": "*", "retry_after_ms": 400})
    return {"draining": True}


@app.websocket("/ws/room/{room}/{peer_id}")
async def ws_room(websocket: WebSocket, room: str, peer_id: str):
    if draining:
        await websocket.close(code=1013, reason="server draining")
        return
    if MODE == "public" and REDIS_URL and not await redis_available():
        await websocket.accept()
        await websocket.send_json({"type": "service_unavailable", "message": "Table signaling is starting; please retry shortly."})
        await websocket.close(code=1013, reason="signaling backend unavailable")
        return
    role = websocket.query_params.get("role", "player")
    room = "".join(c for c in room.upper() if c.isalnum() or c == "-")[:24]
    peer_id = peer_id[:96]
    if not room or not peer_id:
        await websocket.close(code=1008, reason="invalid room")
        return
    if role != "host" and not await _host_online(room):
        log.info("rtc-host-offline room=%s role=%s peer=%s", room, role, peer_id[-8:])
        await websocket.accept()
        await websocket.send_json({"type": "host_offline"})
        await websocket.close(code=4004, reason="host offline")
        return
    await websocket.accept()
    route_id = f"host:{peer_id}" if role == "host" else peer_id
    connection_id = uuid.uuid4().hex
    connection_marker = f"{peer_id}:{connection_id}"
    if redis_client:
        if role == "host":
            await redis_client.set(f"lantern:room:{room}:host", connection_marker, ex=43200)
        await redis_client.set(f"lantern:room:{room}:peer:{peer_id}", f"{role}:{connection_id}", ex=43200)
        pubsub = redis_client.pubsub()
        await pubsub.subscribe(f"lantern:room:{room}", "lantern:drain")
    else:
        local_room_peers.setdefault(room, {})[route_id] = websocket
        pubsub = None

    async def relay_pubsub():
        if not pubsub:
            return
        try:
            async for item in pubsub.listen():
                if item.get("type") != "message":
                    continue
                try:
                    msg = json.loads(item.get("data") or "{}")
                except Exception:
                    continue
                if item.get("channel") == "lantern:drain":
                    await websocket.send_json(msg)
                    continue
                if msg.get("sender") == peer_id:
                    continue
                target = msg.get("target", "*")
                if target not in {"*", peer_id}:
                    continue
                await websocket.send_json(msg)
        except Exception:
            return

    relay_task = asyncio.create_task(relay_pubsub()) if pubsub else None
    await _room_publish(room, {"type": "presence", "event": "joined", "sender": peer_id, "target": "*", "role": role})
    try:
        while True:
            data = await websocket.receive_json()
            if redis_client:
                await redis_client.expire(f"lantern:room:{room}:peer:{peer_id}", 43200)
                if role == "host":
                    await redis_client.expire(f"lantern:room:{room}:host", 43200)
            signal_type = str(data.get("type", "signal"))[:32]
            payload = data.get("payload") if isinstance(data.get("payload"), dict) else {}
            target = str(data.get("target", "*"))[:96]
            if signal_type == "diagnostic":
                pair = payload.get("candidatePair") if isinstance(payload.get("candidatePair"), dict) else {}
                log.info(
                    "rtc room=%s role=%s peer=%s event=%s pc=%s ice=%s gathering=%s signaling=%s candidates=%s pair=%s",
                    room,
                    role,
                    peer_id[-8:],
                    str(payload.get("event", "unknown"))[:40],
                    str(payload.get("connectionState", ""))[:24],
                    str(payload.get("iceConnectionState", ""))[:24],
                    str(payload.get("iceGatheringState", ""))[:24],
                    str(payload.get("signalingState", ""))[:24],
                    json.dumps(payload.get("candidateTypes", []))[:160],
                    json.dumps({key: pair.get(key) for key in ("state", "localType", "remoteType", "protocol", "relayProtocol") if key in pair})[:240],
                )
                continue
            if signal_type in {"hello", "offer", "answer", "ice"}:
                log.info("rtc-signal room=%s role=%s peer=%s type=%s target=%s", room, role, peer_id[-8:], signal_type, target[-8:] if target != "*" else "*")
            msg = {"type": signal_type, "sender": peer_id, "target": target, "payload": data.get("payload")}
            await _room_publish(room, msg)
    except WebSocketDisconnect:
        pass
    finally:
        if relay_task:
            relay_task.cancel()
        if pubsub:
            try:
                await pubsub.unsubscribe()
                await pubsub.close()
            except Exception:
                pass
        if redis_client:
            peer_key = f"lantern:room:{room}:peer:{peer_id}"
            peer_value = await redis_client.get(peer_key)
            if peer_value == f"{role}:{connection_id}":
                await redis_client.delete(peer_key)
            if role == "host":
                host_key = f"lantern:room:{room}:host"
                current = await redis_client.get(host_key)
                if current == connection_marker:
                    await redis_client.delete(host_key)
        else:
            local_room_peers.get(room, {}).pop(route_id, None)
        await _room_publish(room, {"type": "presence", "event": "left", "sender": peer_id, "target": "*", "role": role})

@app.get("/auth/start")
async def auth_start(return_to: str | None = None):
    if MODE == "public":
        raise HTTPException(409, "ChatGPT sign-in runs on the host device companion, not the public signaling service")
    state = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
    nonce = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
    verifier = secrets.token_urlsafe(64)
    challenge = b64url(hashlib.sha256(verifier.encode()).digest())
    pending.clear()
    pending.update(state=state, nonce=nonce, verifier=verifier, return_to=validated_return_to(return_to))

    existing = current_creds()
    client_id = existing.get("client_id") if existing else "dynamic_agent_client"
    params = {
        "client_id": client_id,
        "ext_agent_host_id": host_id(),
        "response_type": "code",
        "redirect_uri": REDIRECT_URI,
        "scope": SCOPES,
        "resource": RESOURCE,
        "state": state,
        "nonce": nonce,
        "code_challenge_method": "S256",
        "code_challenge": challenge,
    }
    if existing:
        if existing.get("id_token"):
            params["id_token_hint"] = existing["id_token"]
        if existing.get("email"):
            params["login_hint"] = existing["email"]
    else:
        params["agent_name_hint"] = APP_NAME
    return RedirectResponse(str(httpx.URL(AUTH_URL, params=params)))


@app.get("/auth/callback")
async def auth_callback(request: Request):
    if MODE == "public":
        raise HTTPException(409, "OAuth callback belongs on the host device companion")
    q = request.query_params
    if q.get("state") != pending.get("state"):
        raise HTTPException(400, "OAuth state mismatch")
    if q.get("error"):
        raise HTTPException(400, f"ChatGPT authorization denied: {q.get('error')}")
    code = q.get("code")
    if not code:
        raise HTTPException(400, "Missing authorization code")

    existing = current_creds()
    callback_client = q.get("client_id")
    client_id = callback_client or (existing or {}).get("client_id")
    if not client_id or client_id == "dynamic_agent_client":
        raise HTTPException(400, "Registration did not return an issued client_id")
    if existing and callback_client and callback_client != existing.get("client_id"):
        raise HTTPException(400, "Unexpected client_id for returning ChatGPT account")

    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=30) as client:
        r = await client.post(
            TOKEN_URL,
            data={
                "grant_type": "authorization_code",
                "client_id": client_id,
                "code": code,
                "code_verifier": pending["verifier"],
                "redirect_uri": REDIRECT_URI,
                "resource": RESOURCE,
            },
        )
    if r.is_error:
        raise HTTPException(r.status_code, f"Token exchange failed: {r.text[:400]}")
    tok = r.json()
    claims = verify_id_token(tok["id_token"], client_id, pending["nonce"])
    scopes = tok.get("scope", q.get("scope", "")).split()
    record = {
        "email": claims.get("email"),
        "name": claims.get("name"),
        "issuer": claims.get("iss"),
        "subject": claims.get("sub"),
        "client_id": client_id,
        "ext_agent_host_id": host_id(),
        "id_token": tok.get("id_token"),
        "access_token": tok.get("access_token"),
        "refresh_token": tok.get("refresh_token"),
        "token_type": tok.get("token_type", "Bearer"),
        "expires_in": int(tok.get("expires_in", 3600)),
        "expires_at": time.time() + int(tok.get("expires_in", 3600)),
        "scopes": scopes,
        "saved_at": time.time(),
    }
    atomic_private_json(CRED_PATH, record)
    return_to = auth_return_url(pending.get("return_to") or f"http://{HOST}:{PORT}/")
    pending.clear()
    return RedirectResponse(return_to)


@app.get("/auth/logout")

    try:
        CRED_PATH.unlink()
    except FileNotFoundError:
        pass
    return RedirectResponse("/")

def build_history(body: dict[str, Any]) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
    history: list[dict[str, str]] = []
    opening = str(body.get("opening_request") or "").strip()
    if opening:
        history.append({"role": "user", "content": f"[TABLE DIRECTIVE — do not quote this instruction] {opening}"})
    for message in body.get("messages", [])[-20:]:
        if message.get("who") == "System":
            continue
        role = "assistant" if message.get("kind") == "dm" else "user"
        text = str(message.get("text", "")).strip()
        if text:
            history.append({"role": role, "content": text})
    return history


def dm_instructions(body: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    settings = body.get("campaign_settings", {})
    return f"""You are the Dungeon Master for a collaborative tabletop fantasy RPG named {body.get('campaign', 'Lantern Table')}.

PLAY STYLE
- Write the spoken/narrated part of every turn as clean Markdown. Use short headings, emphasis, blockquotes, lists, and tables only when they improve playability.
- Be vivid but interactive: usually 2-6 short paragraphs. Never decide a player character's thoughts, dialogue, or choices.
- Respect the campaign controls: {json.dumps(settings, ensure_ascii=False)}
- The campaign is intentionally lazy-built. Invent only what is needed now, preserve established facts, and let the table add detail later.
- Do not fabricate dice results. Use request_roll only when uncertainty matters.
- Players own character identity/background, but mechanical fields (HP, max HP, AC, level, conditions, location) are game-authoritative. Use set_character_mechanics to establish/correct starting stats and propose_state_patch for damage/healing.
- Treat local host state as authoritative.

UI AND GAME TOOLS
- Always call set_next_moves exactly once per DM turn with 2-5 concrete options. Players may still type anything.
- Use render_card for important NPCs, monsters, clues, items, factions, quests, or locations when a compact reference helps.
- Use propose_state_patch for durable changes. When applying HP changes, name the affected character. Keep patches small and explain why.
- Use set_character_mechanics when a new quick-start character needs authoritative starting HP/AC/level. Do this early in the opening if the sheet still has placeholder mechanics.
- Use suggest_visual_prompt when art would materially help. Lantern Table does not generate images; provide a polished prompt for the user to copy elsewhere.

ATMOSPHERE TOOL
Use set_atmosphere only on meaningful environmental/emotional transitions, not every turn. Player devices may opt out. Choose for readability first, mood second. A theme is a scene-lighting cue, not a reward animation. Preserve a theme across nearby rooms unless mood or environment materially changes.

Theme families and suggested story use:
- Hearth / refuge / human warmth: lantern, black-gold, white-gold, gruvbox-dark/light, autumn. Pair lantern + dust; embers only when fire is present.
- Crypt / horror / oppressive darkness: dracula, ash, matte-black, pitch-black, rose-pine-moon, halloween. Pair fog/dust/lantern; use storm only for actual weather or a supernatural shock.
- Winter / ice / exposed mountains: winter-frost, nord-dark/light, graphite-dark/light. Pair snow/fog; keep intensity low during dialogue.
- Forest / earth / old natural magic: everforest-dark/light, kanagawa-wave/dragon/lotus, mist-gb. Pair fireflies/dust/fog.
- Rain / city / ship / nocturnal travel: tokyo-night-storm, tokyo-night, night-owl, nord-dark. Pair rain and occasional storm.
- Ocean / flooded ruins / reflective shores: rose-pine-moon, berry-nebula, kanagawa-wave, summer-beach. Use water for shore/reflection; underwater + bubbles only when actually submerged.
- Arcane / dream / cosmic / planar: berry-nebula, catppuccin-mocha/macchiato/frappe, rose-pine, inkpink, sweet, twilight-5. Pair stars/aurora/fireflies.
- Bright daylight / social / hopeful: ayu-light, rose-pine-dawn, github-light, catppuccin-latte, serika-light, modus-operandi, whitesur-light, graphite-light, white-gold, summer-beach. Prefer no effects or very subtle dust.
- Combat / fire / destruction / urgency: autumn, black-gold, gruvbox-dark, ayu-dark, midnight-ablaze, lava-gb, rust-gold-8. Pair embers/dust; never use constant flashing.
- Machinery / strange technology / glitch: tokyo-night, one-dark, graphite-dark, matte-black, 2bit-demichrome, pico-8, nintendo-gameboy, slso8. Usually use no weather; stars/aurora only for explicitly digital/cosmic scenes.
- Ceremony / festival / celebration: diwali, lunar-new-year, christmas, hanukkah, st-patricks-day, valentine, blessing. Use effects that match the fiction rather than the palette name.
- Retro / surreal / stylized one-off scenes: oil-6, pollen8, vinik24, mist-gb, lava-gb, 2bit-demichrome, pico-8, slso8. Use sparingly so they feel intentional.
- Rhiannon-night is literary/celestial: near-black with warm cream, blush/lavender/gold feeling; use for magical, intimate, reflective scenes and soft starlight.

Effect semantics:
- snow: falling outdoor/ruined snow; rain: visible rainfall; dust: motes/age/sunbeams; embers: nearby heat/fire; fireflies: living magic/forest dusk; fog: obscured depth; lantern: warm local light; bubbles: submerged water; water: reflective/rippled surface; underwater: full-screen caustic/submerged feel; aurora: magical sky/planar glow; storm: rain plus brief lightning; stars: celestial/void ambience.
- Do not stack more than 2-3 effects unless it is a brief climax. Never use storm merely to make combat exciting.
- Transitions should usually be 900-2400ms. Use intensity 0.15-0.45 normally; exceed 0.65 only for short dramatic moments. If players need to read dense cards, lower effects instead of increasing them.

CURRENT LOCAL STATE
Scene: {json.dumps(body.get('scene', {}), ensure_ascii=False)}
Characters: {json.dumps(body.get('characters', body.get('party', [])), ensure_ascii=False)}
Quests: {json.dumps(body.get('quests', []), ensure_ascii=False)}
Inventory: {json.dumps(body.get('inventory', []), ensure_ascii=False)}
Recent timeline: {json.dumps(body.get('timeline', [])[-20:], ensure_ascii=False)}
Recent journal: {str(body.get('journal', ''))[-5000:]}
"""


@app.post("/api/dm/stream")
async def api_dm_stream(request: Request):
    if MODE == "public":
        raise HTTPException(503, "Run the Lantern Table companion on the host device for ChatGPT-plan inference")
    creds = await auth_creds()
    body = await request.json()
    model = await choose_model(creds, body.get("model"))
    payload = {
        "model": model,
        "instructions": dm_instructions(body),
        "input": build_history(body),
        "tools": [
            {
                "type": "namespace",
                "name": "lantern",
                "description": "Lantern Table client-side game presentation and local-state tools.",
                "tools": DM_TOOLS,
            }
        ],
        "tool_choice": "auto",
        "parallel_tool_calls": True,
        "store": False,
        "stream": True,
    }

    async def events() -> AsyncIterator[str]:
        yield sse("meta", {"model": model, "phase": "thinking"})
        tool_calls: dict[int, dict[str, Any]] = {}
        sent_tools: set[str] = set()
        completed = False
        try:
            timeout = httpx.Timeout(180.0, connect=30.0)
            async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=timeout) as client:
                async with client.stream(
                    "POST",
                    f"{RESOURCE}/responses",
                    headers={
                        "Authorization": f"Bearer {creds['access_token']}",
                        "Content-Type": "application/json",
                    },
                    json=payload,
                ) as r:
                    if r.is_error:
                        text = (await r.aread()).decode(errors="replace")
                        yield sse("error", {"message": text[:1200], "status": r.status_code})
                        return
                    async for line in r.aiter_lines():
                        if not line.startswith("data:"):
                            continue
                        data = line[5:].strip()
                        if not data or data == "[DONE]":
                            continue
                        try:
                            event = json.loads(data)
                        except json.JSONDecodeError:
                            continue
                        etype = event.get("type")
                        if etype == "response.output_text.delta":
                            delta = event.get("delta", "")
                            if delta:
                                yield sse("delta", {"delta": delta})
                        elif etype == "response.output_item.added":
                            item = event.get("item", {})
                            if item.get("type") == "function_call":
                                idx = int(event.get("output_index", len(tool_calls)))
                                tool_calls[idx] = dict(item)
                                yield sse("tool_status", {"name": item.get("name"), "status": "preparing"})
                        elif etype == "response.function_call_arguments.delta":
                            idx = int(event.get("output_index", -1))
                            if idx in tool_calls:
                                tool_calls[idx]["arguments"] = tool_calls[idx].get("arguments", "") + event.get("delta", "")
                        elif etype == "response.output_item.done":
                            item = event.get("item", {})
                            if item.get("type") == "function_call":
                                key = item.get("call_id") or item.get("id") or str(event.get("output_index"))
                                if key not in sent_tools:
                                    sent_tools.add(key)
                                    try:
                                        args = json.loads(item.get("arguments") or "{}")
                                    except json.JSONDecodeError:
                                        args = {"raw": item.get("arguments", "")}
                                    yield sse("tool", {"name": item.get("name"), "arguments": args, "call_id": key})
                        elif etype == "response.failed":
                            err = (event.get("response") or {}).get("error") or event.get("error") or {}
                            yield sse("error", {"message": err.get("message") or str(err), "code": err.get("code")})
                            return
                        elif etype == "response.incomplete":
                            yield sse("error", {"message": "The DM response was incomplete. Try again."})
                            return
                        elif etype == "response.completed":
                            completed = True
                            response = event.get("response", {})
                            usage = response.get("usage") or {}
                            # Fallback: emit any function calls present in the terminal response.
                            for item in response.get("output", []):
                                if item.get("type") != "function_call":
                                    continue
                                key = item.get("call_id") or item.get("id") or secrets.token_hex(4)
                                if key in sent_tools:
                                    continue
                                sent_tools.add(key)
                                try:
                                    args = json.loads(item.get("arguments") or "{}")
                                except json.JSONDecodeError:
                                    args = {"raw": item.get("arguments", "")}
                                yield sse("tool", {"name": item.get("name"), "arguments": args, "call_id": key})
                            yield sse("done", {"model": model, "usage": usage})
                            return
            if not completed:
                yield sse("error", {"message": "The DM stream ended before response.completed."})
        except httpx.HTTPError as exc:
            yield sse("error", {"message": f"OpenAI connection error: {exc}"})
        except Exception as exc:
            yield sse("error", {"message": f"DM stream error: {exc}"})

    return StreamingResponse(
        events(),
        media_type="text/event-stream",
        headers={"Cache-Control": "no-cache", "X-Accel-Buffering": "no"},
    )

FROM ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:python3.12-bookworm-slim

ENV PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 \
    PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 \
    HOME=/home/lantern \
    LANTERN_BIND=0.0.0.0 \
    LANTERN_PORT=8765

RUN useradd --create-home --uid 1000 --shell /usr/sbin/nologin lantern \
    && mkdir -p /app /home/lantern/.config/lantern-table \
    && chown -R lantern:lantern /app /home/lantern

WORKDIR /app

# Install runtime dependencies at build time so the pod does not need to resolve
# Python dependencies when it starts.
RUN uv pip install --system \
    'fastapi>=0.118' \
    'uvicorn[standard]>=0.37' \
    'httpx>=0.28' \
    'PyJWT[crypto]>=2.10' \
    'redis>=6.0' \
    'qrcode>=8.0' \
    'websockets>=13.0'

# Fail the image build if Uvicorn cannot load its WebSocket protocol.
RUN python -c "import websockets; import uvicorn.protocols.websockets.websockets_impl"

COPY --chown=lantern:lantern dnd_chatgpt_server.py dnd_localfirst_demo.html ./
COPY --chown=lantern:lantern assets ./assets
COPY --chown=lantern:lantern CREDITS.md ./CREDITS.md

USER 1000:1000
EXPOSE 8765

CMD ["python", "/app/dnd_chatgpt_server.py"]

FILE: justfile
================================================
set shell := ["bash", "-eu", "-o", "pipefail", "-c"]
set dotenv-load := true

registry := env_var_or_default("REGISTRY", "registry.wayl.one")
image_name := env_var_or_default("IMAGE_NAME", "lantern-table")
commit := `git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo local`
timestamp := `date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S`
tag := env_var_or_default("TAG", commit + "-" + timestamp)
image := registry + "/" + image_name + ":" + tag
engine := env_var_or_default("CONTAINER_ENGINE", "podman")
namespace := env_var_or_default("NAMESPACE", "lantern-table")
app := "lantern-table"

# Show recipes.
default:
    @just --list

image:
    @echo "{{image}}"

# Run the host-side OAuth/AI companion locally.
companion:
    LANTERN_MODE=companion ./dnd_chatgpt_server.py

# Build the public signaling/UI image.
build:
    {{engine}} build --pull -t {{image}} .

push:
    {{engine}} push {{image}}

publish: build push

# Apply manifests directly. Prefer Argo after initial testing.
apply:
    kubectl apply -k k8s

# Full direct deploy: validate, publish a unique tag, apply, roll out, and smoke-test.
deploy: validate publish apply
    kubectl -n {{namespace}} set image deployment/{{app}} app={{image}}
    kubectl -n {{namespace}} rollout status deployment/{{app}} --timeout=240s
    just doctor

# Useful only when intentionally testing :latest.
deploy-latest:
    TAG=latest just publish
    kubectl apply -k k8s
    kubectl -n {{namespace}} rollout restart deployment/{{app}}
    kubectl -n {{namespace}} rollout status deployment/{{app}} --timeout=240s

# Create/update optional Cloudflare TURN credentials without writing them to Git.
turn-secret:
    #!/usr/bin/env bash
    set -euo pipefail
    if [[ -z "${CLOUDFLARE_TURN_KEY_ID:-}" || -z "${CLOUDFLARE_TURN_API_TOKEN:-}" ]]; then
      cat <<'EOF'
    Cloudflare TURN setup:
      1. Open https://dash.cloudflare.com/ and select your account.
      2. Open Realtime -> TURN and create a TURN key.
      3. Copy the TURN Key ID and its generated key token.
         The token is shown only when the key is created. Keep it private.
      Docs: https://developers.cloudflare.com/realtime/turn/generate-credentials/

    Press Enter when you have the Key ID and token ready to paste.
    EOF
      read -r -p "Ready? Press Enter to continue: " _
      if [[ -z "${CLOUDFLARE_TURN_KEY_ID:-}" ]]; then
        read -r -p "Paste TURN Key ID: " CLOUDFLARE_TURN_KEY_ID
      fi
      if [[ -z "${CLOUDFLARE_TURN_API_TOKEN:-}" ]]; then
        read -r -s -p "Paste TURN key token (hidden): " CLOUDFLARE_TURN_API_TOKEN
        printf '\n'
      fi
    fi
    test -n "${CLOUDFLARE_TURN_KEY_ID:-}" || { echo "TURN Key ID is required" >&2; exit 2; }
    test -n "${CLOUDFLARE_TURN_API_TOKEN:-}" || { echo "TURN key token is required" >&2; exit 2; }
    kubectl apply -f k8s/namespace.yaml >/dev/null
    kubectl -n {{namespace}} create secret generic lantern-table-turn \
      --from-literal=CLOUDFLARE_TURN_KEY_ID="$CLOUDFLARE_TURN_KEY_ID" \
      --from-literal=CLOUDFLARE_TURN_API_TOKEN="$CLOUDFLARE_TURN_API_TOKEN" \
      --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
    kubectl -n {{namespace}} rollout restart deployment/{{app}}
    kubectl -n {{namespace}} rollout status deployment/{{app}} --timeout=240s
    just doctor

render:
    kubectl kustomize k8s

rollout:
    kubectl -n {{namespace}} rollout status deployment/{{app}} --timeout=240s

restart:
    kubectl -n {{namespace}} rollout restart deployment/{{app}}
    just rollout

status:
    kubectl -n {{namespace}} get deploy,po,svc,ingress,pdb -o wide

logs:
    kubectl -n {{namespace}} logs deployment/{{app}} -f --tail=200

logs-valkey:
    kubectl -n {{namespace}} logs deployment/lantern-valkey -f --tail=100

validate:
    python -m py_compile dnd_chatgpt_server.py
    if command -v node >/dev/null; then node --check assets/app.js; fi
    if command -v kubectl >/dev/null; then kubectl kustomize k8s >/dev/null; fi
    @echo "Lantern Table validation passed"

delete:
    kubectl delete -k k8s --ignore-not-found

# Production smoke test after a rollout.
doctor:
    @echo "== Kubernetes =="
    kubectl -n {{namespace}} get deploy,po,svc,ingress,pdb -o wide
    @echo "== Valkey =="
    kubectl -n {{namespace}} exec deployment/lantern-valkey -- valkey-cli ping
    @echo "== Public health =="
    curl -fsS https://dnd.waylonwalker.com/health/live; echo
    curl -fsS https://dnd.waylonwalker.com/health/ready; echo
    @echo "== Runtime config =="
    curl -fsS https://dnd.waylonwalker.com/api/config; echo
    @echo "Lantern Table doctor passed"

function randomCharacterName(excluded=[]){
  const used=new Set(excluded.filter(Boolean).map(name=>String(name).trim().toLocaleLowerCase()));
  const combinations=CHARACTER_FIRST_NAMES.length*CHARACTER_LAST_NAMES.length;
  const start=Math.floor(Math.random()*combinations);
  for(let offset=0;offset<combinations;offset++){
    const index=(start+offset)%combinations;
    const name=`${CHARACTER_FIRST_NAMES[index%CHARACTER_FIRST_NAMES.length]} ${CHARACTER_LAST_NAMES[Math.floor(index/CHARACTER_FIRST_NAMES.length)]}`;
    if(!used.has(name.toLocaleLowerCase()))return name;
  }
  const first=CHARACTER_FIRST_NAMES[Math.floor(Math.random()*CHARACTER_FIRST_NAMES.length)];
  const last=CHARACTER_LAST_NAMES[Math.floor(Math.random()*CHARACTER_LAST_NAMES.length)];
  for(let suffix=2;;suffix++){const name=`${first} ${last} ${suffix}`;if(!used.has(name.toLocaleLowerCase()))return name}
}

const CHARACTER_SUBCLASSES = {
  Cleric:['Life','Light','Trickery'],
  Sorcerer:['Draconic Bloodline','Wild Magic'],
  Warlock:['Archfey','Fiend','Great Old One']

function randomItem(items){return items[Math.floor(Math.random()*items.length)]}
function shuffle(items){for(let i=items.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));[items[i],items[j]]=[items[j],items[i]]}return items}
function rollAbilityScore(){const dice=Array.from({length:4},()=>1+Math.floor(Math.random()*6));return dice.sort((a,b)=>b-a).slice(0,3).reduce((sum,die)=>sum+die,0)}
function createRandomCharacter({id=uid('char'),ownerPlayerId=null,location='Lantern Room',nameExclusions=[],notes=''}={}){
  const className=randomItem(Object.keys(CHARACTER_CLASSES)),classData=CHARACTER_CLASSES[className];
  const species=randomItem(CHARACTER_SPECIES),background=randomItem(CHARACTER_BACKGROUNDS),subclass=randomItem(CHARACTER_SUBCLASSES[className]||['']),abilityKeys=['str','dex','con','int','wis','cha'];
  const scores=shuffle(Array.from({length:6},rollAbilityScore)),abilities=Object.fromEntries(abilityKeys.map((key,index)=>[key,scores[index]]));
  Object.entries(species.bonuses).forEach(([key,bonus])=>abilities[key]+=bonus);
  if(species.chooseTwoBonuses)shuffle(abilityKeys.filter(key=>key!=='cha')).slice(0,2).forEach(key=>abilities[key]++);
  const backgroundSkills=[...background.skills];
  const skillOptions=(classData.skills||Object.keys(CHARACTER_DEFAULTS.skills)).filter(key=>!backgroundSkills.includes(key));
  const classSkills=shuffle(skillOptions).slice(0,classData.skillCount);
  const skills={...CHARACTER_DEFAULTS.skills};
  [...backgroundSkills,...classSkills].forEach(key=>skills[key]=true);
  if(species.chooseTwoSkills)shuffle(Object.keys(skills).filter(key=>!skills[key])).slice(0,2).forEach(key=>skills[key]=true);
  const saves={...CHARACTER_DEFAULTS.saves};
  classData.saves.forEach(key=>saves[key]=true);
  const constitutionModifier=abilityModifier(abilities.con),dexterityModifier=abilityModifier(abilities.dex),wisdomModifier=abilityModifier(abilities.wis);
  const draconicOrigin=className==='Sorcerer'&&subclass==='Draconic Bloodline';
  const hitPoints=Math.max(1,classData.hitDie+constitutionModifier+(draconicOrigin?1:0));
  const armorClass=draconicOrigin?13+dexterityModifier:className==='Barbarian'?10+dexterityModifier+constitutionModifier:className==='Monk'?10+dexterityModifier+wisdomModifier:className==='Cleric'?16+Math.min(dexterityModifier,2):className==='Fighter'||className==='Paladin'?18:className==='Druid'?13+dexterityModifier:className==='Ranger'?14+Math.min(dexterityModifier,2):className==='Bard'||className==='Rogue'||className==='Warlock'?11+dexterityModifier:10+dexterityModifier;
  const spells=[],magic=CHARACTER_SPELLS[className];
  if(magic){
    shuffle([...magic.cantrips]).slice(0,magic.cantripCount).forEach(spell=>spells.push(`Cantrip: ${spell}`));
    if(magic.known)shuffle([...magic.known]).slice(0,magic.knownCount).forEach(spell=>spells.push(`Known 1st-level spell: ${spell}`));
    if(magic.prepared){const preparedCount=Math.max(1,1+wisdomModifier);shuffle([...magic.prepared]).slice(0,preparedCount).forEach(spell=>spells.push(`Prepared 1st-level spell: ${spell}`))}
    if(magic.spellbook){
      const spellbook=shuffle([...magic.spellbook]).slice(0,magic.spellbookCount);
      spellbook.forEach(spell=>spells.push(`Spellbook: ${spell}`));
      const preparedCount=Math.max(1,1+abilityModifier(abilities.int));
      shuffle(spellbook).slice(0,preparedCount).forEach(spell=>spells.push(`Prepared 1st-level spell: ${spell}`))
    }
  }
  if(species.name==='Tiefling')spells.push('Racial cantrip: Thaumaturgy');
  if(species.name==='High Elf')spells.push(`Racial cantrip: ${randomItem(CHARACTER_SPELLS.Wizard.cantrips)}`);
  if(species.name==='Forest Gnome')spells.push('Racial cantrip: Minor Illusion');
  if(className==='Cleric'){
    const domainSpells={Life:['Bless','Cure Wounds'],Light:['Burning Hands','Faerie Fire'],Trickery:['Charm Person','Disguise Self']}[subclass];
    domainSpells.forEach(spell=>spells.push(`Domain spell: ${spell}`))
  }
  const features=[...classData.features,...(species.features||[])];
  if(className==='Cleric')features.push(...({Life:['Heavy Armor Proficiency','Disciple of Life'],Light:['Bonus Cantrip: Light','Warding Flare'],Trickery:['Blessing of the Trickster']}[subclass]));
  if(className==='Sorcerer')features.push(...(draconicOrigin?['Draconic Resilience','Draconic Ancestor']:['Wild Magic Surge','Tides of Chaos']));
  if(className==='Warlock')features.push(...({Archfey:['Fey Presence'],Fiend:["Dark One's Blessing"],'Great Old One':['Awakened Mind']}[subclass]));
  const backgroundGear=BACKGROUND_STARTING_GEAR[background.name];
  return {
    ...clone(CHARACTER_DEFAULTS),id,ownerPlayerId,name:randomCharacterName(nameExclusions),class:className,level:1,
    species:species.name,background:background.name,subclass,alignment:randomItem(['Lawful Good','Neutral Good','Chaotic Good','Lawful Neutral','True Neutral','Chaotic Neutral','Lawful Evil','Neutral Evil','Chaotic Evil']),
    speed:species.speed,hitDice:`1d${classData.hitDie}`,proficiencyBonus:2,initiative:dexterityModifier,ac:armorClass,
    hp:hitPoints,maxHp:hitPoints,notes,location,inspiration:false,abilities,saves,skills,features,
    inventory:[...CLASS_STARTING_GEAR[className],...backgroundGear.items],currency:backgroundGear.currency,spells,
    spellSlots:magic?`${magic.slots} 1st-level slot${magic.slots===1?'':'s'}`:'',
    creationVersion:1
  }
}

function mergeDefaults(base, value){
  if(Array.isArray(base)) return Array.isArray(value)?value:clone(base);
  if(base && typeof base==='object'){const out={};for(const k of Object.keys(base))out[k]=mergeDefaults(base[k],value?.[k]);for(const k of Object.keys(value||{}))if(!(k in out))out[k]=value[k];return out}
  return value===undefined?base:value;
}

// Minimal Markdown renderer: escapes HTML first, then applies a safe subset.
function markdown(src=''){
  let s=esc(src).replace(/```([\s\S]*?)```/g,'<pre><code>$1</code></pre>');
  s=s.replace(/^### (.*)$/gm,'<h3>$1</h3>').replace(/^## (.*)$/gm,'<h2>$1</h2>').replace(/^# (.*)$/gm,'<h1>$1</h1>');
  s=s.replace(/^&gt; (.*)$/gm,'<blockquote>$1</blockquote>');
  s=s.replace(/\*\*(.*?)\*\*/g,'<strong>$1</strong>').replace(/\*(.*?)\*/g,'<em>$1</em>').replace(/`([^`]+)`/g,'<code>$1</code>');
  const lines=s.split('\n');let out=[],inUl=false,inOl=false;
  for(const line of lines){
    if(/^[-*] /.test(line)){if(!inUl){out.push('<ul>');inUl=true}out.push(`<li>${line.slice(2)}</li>`);continue}else if(inUl){out.push('</ul>');inUl=false}
    if(/^\d+\. /.test(line)){if(!inOl){out.push('<ol>');inOl=true}out.push(`<li>${line.replace(/^\d+\. /,'')}</li>`);continue}else if(inOl){out.push('</ol>');inOl=false}
    if(/^<(h\d|blockquote|pre)/.test(line)||/^<\/(h\d|blockquote|pre)/.test(line)){out.push(line);continue}
    if(line.trim())out.push(`<p>${line}</p>`)
  }
  if(inUl)out.push('</ul>');if(inOl)out.push('</ol>');return out.join('');
}

function renderTranscript(){
  const el=$('transcript'),scroller=document.scrollingElement;
  const nearBottom=scroller.scrollHeight-scroller.scrollTop-scroller.clientHeight<64;
  const selection=getSelection(),hasSelection=selection&&!selection.isCollapsed&&(el.contains(selection.anchorNode)||el.contains(selection.focusNode));
  const messages=state.messages.slice(-80),activeIds=new Set(messages.map(m=>m.id));
  let cursor=el.firstElementChild;
  for(const m of messages){
    let card=transcriptNodes.get(m.id);
    if(!card&&streamNode&&m.kind==='dm'&&streamNode.dataset.renderedText?.trim()===m.text){
      card=streamNode;streamNode=null;
      card.querySelector('.stream-cursor')?.remove();
      card.dataset.renderedText=m.text;card.dataset.renderedFormat=m.format||'';card.dataset.renderedKind=m.kind||'';
      transcriptNodes.set(m.id,card);
    }
    if(!card){
      card=document.createElement('article');card.dataset.messageId=m.id;
      card.innerHTML=`<div class="message-head"><span class="message-who">${esc(m.who)}</span><span class="message-time">${fmtTime(m.at)}</span></div><div class="markdown"></div>`;
      transcriptNodes.set(m.id,card);
    }
    card.className=`message ${m.kind==='dm'?'dm':m.kind==='system'?'system':'player'}`;
    const body=card.querySelector('.markdown');
    if(card.dataset.renderedText!==m.text||card.dataset.renderedFormat!==m.format||card.dataset.renderedKind!==m.kind){
      body.innerHTML=(m.kind==='dm'||m.kind==='system'||m.format==='markdown')?markdown(m.text):`<p>${esc(m.text)}</p>`;
      card.dataset.renderedText=m.text;card.dataset.renderedFormat=m.format||'';card.dataset.renderedKind=m.kind||'';
    }
    if(card!==cursor)el.insertBefore(card,cursor);
    cursor=card.nextElementSibling;
  }
  for(const [id,card] of transcriptNodes){
    if(!activeIds.has(id)){card.remove();transcriptNodes.delete(id)}
  }
  if(streamMessage){
    if(!streamNode){
      streamNode=document.createElement('article');streamNode.className='message dm';
      streamNode.innerHTML='<div class="message-head"><span class="message-who">DM</span><span class="message-time">now</span></div><div class="markdown"><div class="stream-content"></div><span class="stream-cursor"></span></div>';
    }
    if(!(hasSelection&&(streamNode.contains(selection.anchorNode)||streamNode.contains(selection.focusNode)))){
      if(streamNode.dataset.renderedText!==streamMessage.text)streamNode.querySelector('.stream-content').innerHTML=markdown(streamMessage.text);
      streamNode.dataset.renderedText=streamMessage.text;
    }
    if(el.lastElementChild!==streamNode)el.append(streamNode);
  }else if(streamNode){
    streamNode.remove();streamNode=null;
  }
  const scrollIntent=transcriptScrollIntent;
  if(nearBottom&&!hasSelection)requestAnimationFrame(()=>{if(scrollIntent===transcriptScrollIntent)scroller.scrollTo({top:scroller.scrollHeight,behavior:'instant'})});
}
function queueTranscriptRender(){if(transcriptRenderQueued)return;transcriptRenderQueued=true;requestAnimationFrame(()=>{transcriptRenderQueued=false;renderTranscript()})}

    else if(session.reachable){panel.innerHTML=`<div class="status-row"><span class="status-dot warn"></span><b>Companion is running; ChatGPT is not authorized yet</b></div><div class="button-row"><a class="button primary" href="${companionAuthUrl()}">Continue with ChatGPT</a><button class="button" id="probeCompanion">I've signed in — check again</button></div>`}
    else{panel.innerHTML=`<p class="muted">Only the host needs the local AI companion. Joining players never need it.</p><div class="button-row"><button class="button primary" id="showAiSetup">Set up AI DM</button><button class="button" id="probeCompanion">Check running companion</button></div>`}
    $('probeCompanion')?.addEventListener('click',()=>probeCompanion(true));$('showAiSetup')?.addEventListener('click',showAISetup);$('modelSelect')?.addEventListener('change',e=>session.model=e.target.value)
  }else{
    panel.innerHTML=session.connected?`<p>Connected as <b>${esc(session.name||session.email||'ChatGPT user')}</b>.</p><label>Model<select id="modelSelect">${session.models.map(m=>`<option value="${m.slug}" ${session.model===m.slug?'selected':''}>${esc(m.display_name)}</option>`).join('')}</select></label><a class="button" href="/auth/logout">Disconnect</a>`:`<p class="muted">Authorize this host device to use your eligible ChatGPT plan for the Dungeon Master.</p><a class="button primary" href="/auth/start">Continue with ChatGPT</a>`;$('modelSelect')?.addEventListener('change',e=>session.model=e.target.value)
  }
}

function mixHex(a,b,amount){const pa=hexRgb(a),pb=hexRgb(b),v=pa.map((x,i)=>Math.round(x+(pb[i]-x)*amount));return '#'+v.map(x=>x.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('')}
function desiredTheme(id){const mode=state.ui.colorMode||'follow',src=THEMES[id]||THEMES.lantern;if(mode==='follow'||src.variant===mode)return src;const explicit={
  'default-dark':'default-light','default-light':'default-dark','ayu-dark':'ayu-light','ayu-light':'ayu-dark','rose-pine':'rose-pine-dawn','rose-pine-moon':'rose-pine-dawn','rose-pine-dawn':'rose-pine-moon',
  'catppuccin-mocha':'catppuccin-latte','catppuccin-macchiato':'catppuccin-latte','catppuccin-frappe':'catppuccin-latte','catppuccin-latte':'catppuccin-mocha',
  'nord-dark':'nord-light','nord-light':'nord-dark','gruvbox-dark':'gruvbox-light','gruvbox-light':'gruvbox-dark','tokyo-night':'tokyo-night-day','tokyo-night-storm':'tokyo-night-day','tokyo-night-day':'tokyo-night-storm',
  'everforest-dark':'everforest-light','everforest-light':'everforest-dark','kanagawa-dark':'kanagawa-light','kanagawa-light':'kanagawa-dark','kanagawa-wave':'kanagawa-lotus','kanagawa-lotus':'kanagawa-wave',
  'solarized-dark':'solarized-light','solarized-light':'solarized-dark','github-dark':'github-light','github-light':'github-dark','one-dark':'one-light','one-light':'one-dark','modus-vivendi':'modus-operandi','modus-operandi':'modus-vivendi',
  'serika-dark':'serika-light','serika-light':'serika-dark','whitesur-dark':'whitesur-light','whitesur-light':'whitesur-dark','graphite-dark':'graphite-light','graphite-light':'graphite-dark','night-owl':'night-owl-light','night-owl-light':'night-owl'
};const pair=THEMES[explicit[id]];if(pair&&pair.variant===mode)return pair;if(mode==='light')return {...src,name:src.name+' · light',variant:'light',bg:mixHex(src.bg,'#ffffff',.9),surface:mixHex(src.surface,'#ffffff',.82),surface2:mixHex(src.surface2,'#ffffff',.75),surface3:mixHex(src.surface3,'#ffffff',.67),ink:mixHex(src.ink,'#000000',.72),muted:mixHex(src.muted,'#333333',.55),accent:mixHex(src.accent,'#000000',.18)};return {...src,name:src.name+' · dark',variant:'dark',bg:mixHex(src.bg,'#000000',.82),surface:mixHex(src.surface,'#000000',.72),surface2:mixHex(src.surface2,'#000000',.62),surface3:mixHex(src.surface3,'#000000',.5),ink:mixHex(src.ink,'#ffffff',.72),muted:mixHex(src.muted,'#dddddd',.42),accent:mixHex(src.accent,'#ffffff',.12)}}
function applyTheme(id,transitionMs=1200){const t=desiredTheme(id);const root=document.documentElement;root.style.setProperty('--bg',t.bg);root.style.setProperty('--surface',t.surface);root.style.setProperty('--surface2',t.surface2);root.style.setProperty('--surface3',t.surface3);root.style.setProperty('--ink',t.ink);root.style.setProperty('--muted',t.muted);root.style.setProperty('--accent',t.accent);root.style.setProperty('--accent2',t.accent);root.style.colorScheme=t.variant==='light'?'light':'dark';document.querySelector('meta[name=theme-color]').content=t.bg;document.body.style.transition=`background-color ${transitionMs}ms ease,color ${transitionMs}ms ease`;}
function effectStrength(atm=state.atmosphere){if(!state.ui.effectsEnabled)return 0;const local=Math.max(0,Math.min(3,(state.ui.effectIntensity??35)/35));return Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(atm.intensity??.3)*local))}
function clearFxCanvas(){const c=$('fxCanvas'),ctx=c.getContext('2d');ctx.clearRect(0,0,c.width,c.height);fxParticles=[]}
function applyAtmosphere(atm,{silent=false}={}){applyTheme(atm.theme,atm.transition_ms||1200);const chosen=state.ui.manualEffectsOverride?(state.ui.manualEffects||[]):(atm.effects||[]);const effects=state.ui.effectsEnabled?chosen:[];activeEffects=new Set(effects);const strength=effectStrength(atm);$('lanternGlow').style.opacity=activeEffects.has('lantern')?(.22+.62*strength):0;shaderMode=activeEffects.has('underwater')?'underwater':activeEffects.has('water')?'water':activeEffects.has('aurora')?'aurora':'none';$('shaderCanvas').style.opacity=shaderMode==='none'?0:(.24+.58*strength);if(!effects.length)clearFxCanvas();ensureEffectsLoop();ensureShaderLoop();if(!silent&&state.ui.motion)springPage();}
function toggleManualEffect(name){if(!state.ui.manualEffectsOverride){state.ui.manualEffectsOverride=true;state.ui.manualEffects=[...(state.atmosphere.effects||[])]}const a=state.ui.manualEffects;const i=a.indexOf(name);i>=0?a.splice(i,1):a.push(name);save();render();applyAtmosphere(state.atmosphere)}
function springPage(){if(!state.ui.motion)return;const el=document.querySelector('.view.active');if(!el)return;spring(el,{fromScale:.985,fromY:8,damping:20,stiffness:180})}
function spring(el,{fromScale=.96,fromY=12,stiffness=220,damping=18,mass=1}={}){if(!state.ui.motion||matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches)return;let x=1-fromScale,y=fromY,vx=0,vy=0,last=performance.now();const step=(now)=>{const dt=Math.min(.032,(now-last)/1000);last=now;const ax=(-stiffness*x-damping*vx)/mass,ay=(-stiffness*y-damping*vy)/mass;vx+=ax*dt;vy+=ay*dt;x+=vx*dt;y+=vy*dt;el.style.transform=`translateY(${y}px) scale(${1-x})`;el.style.opacity=String(Math.min(1,1-Math.abs(x)*2));if(Math.abs(x)+Math.abs(y)+Math.abs(vx)+Math.abs(vy)>.015)requestAnimationFrame(step);else{el.style.transform='';el.style.opacity=''}};requestAnimationFrame(step)}
function effectBudget(){const mobile=innerWidth<700,cores=navigator.hardwareConcurrency||4,strength=effectStrength();return Math.max(28,Math.min(220,(mobile?55:115)+(cores-4)*9))*(.75+strength*1.25)}
function ensureEffectsLoop(){if(fxRAF)return;const c=$('fxCanvas'),ctx=c.getContext('2d');let last=0;const loop=(ts)=>{fxRAF=requestAnimationFrame(loop);if(document.hidden||!state.ui.effectsEnabled||matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches){clearFxCanvas();return;}if(ts-last<16)return;last=ts;const dpr=Math.min(devicePixelRatio||1,innerWidth<700?1.2:1.6),w=innerWidth,h=innerHeight;if(c.width!==Math.round(w*dpr)||c.height!==Math.round(h*dpr)){c.width=Math.round(w*dpr);c.height=Math.round(h*dpr);c.style.width=w+'px';c.style.height=h+'px';ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0)}ctx.clearRect(0,0,w,h);drawParticles(ctx,w,h,ts)};fxRAF=requestAnimationFrame(loop)}
function drawParticles(ctx,w,h,ts){const wants=[...activeEffects].filter(x=>['snow','rain','dust','embers','fireflies','bubbles','stars','fog','storm'].includes(x));if(!wants.length){fxParticles=[];return}const budget=Math.round(effectBudget());while(fxParticles.length<budget){const type=wants[Math.floor(Math.random()*wants.length)];fxParticles.push(newParticle(type,w,h))}while(fxParticles.length>budget)fxParticles.pop();for(const p of fxParticles){updateParticle(p,w,h);drawParticle(ctx,p,w,h,ts)}if(activeEffects.has('storm')&&Math.random()<.0015*(state.atmosphere.intensity+.2)){$('stormFlash').classList.remove('active');void $('stormFlash').offsetWidth;$('stormFlash').classList.add('active')}}
function newParticle(type,w,h){const base={type,x:Math.random()*w,y:Math.random()*h,z:Math.random(),vx:0,vy:0,size:1+Math.random()*3,life:Math.random()};if(type==='snow'){base.vx=-.2+Math.random()*.5;base.vy=.35+Math.random()*.6;base.size=1+Math.random()*3}else if(type==='rain'||type==='storm'){base.vx=-1-Math.random()*1.5;base.vy=8+Math.random()*9;base.size=8+Math.random()*14}else if(type==='dust'){base.vx=-.08+Math.random()*.16;base.vy=-.05+Math.random()*.1;base.size=.6+Math.random()*1.5}else if(type==='embers'){base.vx=-.15+Math.random()*.3;base.vy=-.4-Math.random()*.7;base.size=1+Math.random()*2}else if(type==='fireflies'){base.vx=-.2+Math.random()*.4;base.vy=-.2+Math.random()*.4;base.size=1.5+Math.random()*2}else if(type==='bubbles'){base.vx=-.15+Math.random()*.3;base.vy=-.4-Math.random()*.8;base.size=2+Math.random()*6}else if(type==='stars'){base.vx=base.vy=0;base.size=.5+Math.random()*1.6}else if(type==='fog'){base.vx=.08+Math.random()*.12;base.vy=0;base.size=90+Math.random()*160}return base}
function updateParticle(p,w,h){if(p.type==='fireflies'){p.vx+=(-.5+Math.random())*.012;p.vy+=(-.5+Math.random())*.012;p.vx*=.99;p.vy*=.99}p.x+=p.vx;p.y+=p.vy;p.life+=.005;if(p.x<-p.size*2||p.x>w+p.size*2||p.y<-p.size*2||p.y>h+p.size*2||p.life>1.6){Object.assign(p,newParticle(p.type,w,h));if(['embers','bubbles'].includes(p.type))p.y=h+10;if(['rain','storm','snow'].includes(p.type))p.y=-20}}
function drawParticle(ctx,p,w,h,ts){const strength=effectStrength(),a=.32+.66*strength;ctx.save();if(p.type==='snow'){ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(255,255,255,${a})`;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,p.size,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill()}else if(p.type==='rain'||p.type==='storm'){ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(170,205,235,${a*.75})`;ctx.lineWidth=1.1+strength*1.4;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(p.x,p.y);ctx.lineTo(p.x-p.vx*2,p.y-p.size);ctx.stroke()}else if(p.type==='dust'){ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(230,205,165,${.18+a*.46})`;ctx.fillRect(p.x,p.y,p.size,p.size)}else if(p.type==='embers'){ctx.shadowBlur=8;ctx.shadowColor='#ff8b38';ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(255,145,65,${a})`;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,p.size,0,6.28);ctx.fill()}else if(p.type==='fireflies'){const pulse=.3+.7*Math.sin(ts*.003+p.x);ctx.shadowBlur=12;ctx.shadowColor='#d6ff93';ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(205,255,130,${a*pulse})`;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,p.size,0,6.28);ctx.fill()}else if(p.type==='bubbles'){ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(180,235,255,${a*.65})`;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,p.size,0,6.28);ctx.stroke()}else if(p.type==='stars'){const pulse=.3+.7*Math.abs(Math.sin(ts*.001+p.x));ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(255,255,255,${a*pulse})`;ctx.fillRect(p.x,p.y,p.size,p.size)}else if(p.type==='fog'){const g=ctx.createRadialGradient(p.x,p.y,0,p.x,p.y,p.size);g.addColorStop(0,`rgba(210,220,225,${.045+a*.085})`);g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(210,220,225,0)');ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,p.size,0,6.28);ctx.fill()}ctx.restore()}
function ensureShaderLoop(){if(glState)return;const c=$('shaderCanvas'),gl=c.getContext('webgl',{alpha:true,antialias:false});if(!gl)return;const vs=`attribute vec2 p;void main(){gl_Position=vec4(p,0.,1.);}`;const fs=`precision mediump float;uniform vec2 r;uniform float t;uniform float m;uniform vec3 a;float wave(vec2 p){return sin(p.x*8.+t)+sin(p.y*11.-t*1.2)+sin((p.x+p.y)*6.+t*.7);}void main(){vec2 uv=gl_FragCoord.xy/r;vec2 p=(uv-.5)*vec2(r.x/r.y,1.);vec3 col=vec3(0.);if(m<.5){col=vec3(0.);}else if(m<1.5){float w=wave(p);float shine=pow(max(0.,sin((p.x+w*.03)*22.+t*1.4)),8.);col=mix(vec3(.005,.04,.07),a*.45,.2+uv.y*.2)+shine*a*.35;}else if(m<2.5){float c1=abs(sin((p.x*7.+sin(p.y*5.+t))*2.));float c2=abs(sin((p.y*9.+sin(p.x*4.-t))*1.4));float ca=pow(max(0.,1.-abs(c1-c2)),7.);col=vec3(.0,.06,.09)+a*.12+ca*vec3(.1,.45,.5)*.5;}else{float band=sin(p.x*3.+sin(p.y*2.+t*.3)*2.+t*.2);float glow=pow(max(0.,band),4.)*(.4+.6*uv.y);col=a*glow*.45+vec3(.01,.02,.05);}gl_FragColor=vec4(col,clamp(length(col)*2.,0.,.75));}`;const sh=(type,src)=>{const s=gl.createShader(type);gl.shaderSource(s,src);gl.compileShader(s);return s};const pr=gl.createProgram();gl.attachShader(pr,sh(gl.VERTEX_SHADER,vs));gl.attachShader(pr,sh(gl.FRAGMENT_SHADER,fs));gl.linkProgram(pr);gl.useProgram(pr);const b=gl.createBuffer();gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER,b);gl.bufferData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER,new Float32Array([-1,-1,3,-1,-1,3]),gl.STATIC_DRAW);const loc=gl.getAttribLocation(pr,'p');gl.enableVertexAttribArray(loc);gl.vertexAttribPointer(loc,2,gl.FLOAT,false,0,0);glState={c,gl,pr,uR:gl.getUniformLocation(pr,'r'),uT:gl.getUniformLocation(pr,'t'),uM:gl.getUniformLocation(pr,'m'),uA:gl.getUniformLocation(pr,'a')};const loop=(ts)=>{shaderRAF=requestAnimationFrame(loop);if(document.hidden||shaderMode==='none'||matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches)return;const dpr=Math.min(devicePixelRatio||1,1.4),w=Math.round(innerWidth*dpr),h=Math.round(innerHeight*dpr);if(c.width!==w||c.height!==h){c.width=w;c.height=h;gl.viewport(0,0,w,h)}const mode=shaderMode==='water'?1:shaderMode==='underwater'?2:shaderMode==='aurora'?3:0;const rgb=hexRgb(desiredTheme(state.atmosphere.theme).accent);gl.uniform2f(glState.uR,w,h);gl.uniform1f(glState.uT,ts*.001);gl.uniform1f(glState.uM,mode);gl.uniform3f(glState.uA,rgb[0]/255,rgb[1]/255,rgb[2]/255);gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLES,0,3)};shaderRAF=requestAnimationFrame(loop)}
function hexRgb(h){h=h.replace('#','');return [parseInt(h.slice(0,2),16),parseInt(h.slice(2,4),16),parseInt(h.slice(4,6),16)]}

const assetUrls=new Map();let dbPromise=null;
function db(){if(!dbPromise)dbPromise=new Promise((res,rej)=>{const q=indexedDB.open('lantern-table-assets',2);q.onupgradeneeded=()=>{if(!q.result.objectStoreNames.contains('assets'))q.result.createObjectStore('assets',{keyPath:'id'})};q.onsuccess=()=>res(q.result);q.onerror=()=>rej(q.error)});return dbPromise}
async function putAsset(blob,meta={}){const id=uid('asset'),rec={id,blob,meta,createdAt:Date.now()};const d=await db();await new Promise((res,rej)=>{const t=d.transaction('assets','readwrite');t.objectStore('assets').put(rec);t.oncomplete=res;t.onerror=()=>rej(t.error)});assetUrls.set(id,URL.createObjectURL(blob));state.assets.push({id,title:meta.title||'Campaign image',kind:meta.kind||'image',createdAt:rec.createdAt});save();render();return id}
async function loadAssetUrls(){const d=await db();const rows=await new Promise((res,rej)=>{const r=d.transaction('assets').objectStore('assets').getAll();r.onsuccess=()=>res(r.result);r.onerror=()=>rej(r.error)});for(const r of rows){if(assetUrls.has(r.id))URL.revokeObjectURL(assetUrls.get(r.id));assetUrls.set(r.id,URL.createObjectURL(r.blob))}}
function getAssetUrl(id){return id?assetUrls.get(id)||'':null}

const narrator={buffer:'',queue:Promise.resolve(),kokoro:null,kokoroLoading:null,voices:[],epoch:0,activeSource:null,activeCtx:null,
  feed(delta){if(!state.audio.autoNarrate||state.audio.mode==='off')return;this.buffer+=delta;let m;while((m=this.buffer.match(/^([\s\S]*?[.!?](?:\s|$))/))&&m[1].trim().length>20){this.buffer=this.buffer.slice(m[1].length);this.speak(m[1].replace(/[#*_>`]/g,'').trim())}},
  flush(){const t=this.buffer.trim();this.buffer='';if(t)this.speak(t.replace(/[#*_>`]/g,''))},
  stop(){this.epoch++;this.buffer='';if('speechSynthesis'in window)speechSynthesis.cancel();try{this.activeSource?.stop()}catch{}try{this.activeCtx?.close()}catch{}this.activeSource=null;this.activeCtx=null;this.queue=Promise.resolve()},
  preview(text){this.stop();this.speak(text)},
  speak(text){if(!text)return;const epoch=this.epoch;if(state.audio.mode==='system')speakSystem(text,true);else if(state.audio.mode==='kokoro')this.queue=this.queue.then(()=>speakKokoro(text,epoch)).catch(e=>{if(epoch===this.epoch){toast('Kokoro fallback: '+e.message);speakSystem(text,true)}})}
};
function voiceParams(){return {normal:{rate:1,pitch:1},creepy:{rate:.82,pitch:.62},ancient:{rate:.76,pitch:.78},urgent:{rate:1.18,pitch:.92}}[state.audio.style]||{rate:1,pitch:1}}
function speakSystem(text,replace=false){if(!('speechSynthesis'in window))return;if(replace)speechSynthesis.cancel();const u=new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text),p=voiceParams(),voices=speechSynthesis.getVoices();u.rate=p.rate;u.pitch=p.pitch;u.volume=.9;u.voice=voices.find(v=>v.name===state.audio.voice)||voices.find(v=>v.localService)||voices[0]||null;speechSynthesis.speak(u)}
async function loadKokoro(){if(narrator.kokoro)return narrator.kokoro;if(narrator.kokoroLoading)return narrator.kokoroLoading;$('kokoroStatus').textContent='Loading Kokoro model locally… this can be a large first download.';narrator.kokoroLoading=(async()=>{const {KokoroTTS}=await import('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/kokoro-js@1.2.1/+esm');const device=('gpu'in navigator)?'webgpu':'wasm';const dtype=device==='webgpu'?'fp32':'q8';const tts=await KokoroTTS.from_pretrained('onnx-community/Kokoro-82M-v1.0-ONNX',{device,dtype,progress_callback:p=>{if(p?.progress!=null)$('kokoroStatus').textContent=`Downloading local voice model… ${Math.round(p.progress)}%`}});narrator.kokoro=tts;$('kokoroStatus').textContent=`Kokoro ready locally (${device}).`;return tts})();return narrator.kokoroLoading}
async function playKokoroBuffer(buffer,epoch){if(epoch!==narrator.epoch)return;const Ctx=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext,ctx=new Ctx(),src=ctx.createBufferSource(),filter=ctx.createBiquadFilter(),dry=ctx.createGain(),wet=ctx.createGain(),delay=ctx.createDelay(.6);narrator.activeCtx=ctx;narrator.activeSource=src;const style=state.audio.style||'normal';src.buffer=buffer;filter.type='lowpass';filter.frequency.value=style==='creepy'?2900:style==='ancient'?4300:7600;dry.gain.value=1;wet.gain.value=style==='creepy'?.16:style==='ancient'?.10:.02;delay.delayTime.value=style==='creepy'?.075:style==='ancient'?.11:.025;src.connect(filter);filter.connect(dry);dry.connect(ctx.destination);filter.connect(delay);delay.connect(wet);wet.connect(ctx.destination);src.start();await new Promise(r=>{src.onended=r});if(narrator.activeSource===src){narrator.activeSource=null;narrator.activeCtx=null}setTimeout(()=>ctx.close().catch(()=>{}),80)}

async function streamPost(path,body,onEvent,signal,base=AI_BASE){const r=await fetch(base+path,{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify(body),signal});if(!r.ok)throw Error((await r.text()).slice(0,900));const reader=r.body.getReader(),dec=new TextDecoder();let buf='';while(true){const {done,value}=await reader.read();if(done)break;buf+=dec.decode(value,{stream:true});let cut;while((cut=buf.indexOf('\n\n'))>=0){const block=buf.slice(0,cut);buf=buf.slice(cut+2);let event='message',data='';for(const line of block.split('\n')){if(line.startsWith('event:'))event=line.slice(6).trim();if(line.startsWith('data:'))data+=line.slice(5).trim()}if(data){try{await onEvent(event,JSON.parse(data))}catch(e){console.error(e)}}}}}

function handleTool(name,a){if(name==='set_next_moves'){state.nextMoves=a.moves||[];renderNextMoves()}else if(name==='request_roll'){state.rollRequest=a;toolCards.push({kind:'roll',...a});renderTools()}else if(name==='set_character_mechanics'){const ch=state.characters.find(c=>c.name===a.character_name)||state.characters.find(c=>(c.name||'').toLowerCase()===(a.character_name||'').toLowerCase());if(ch){if(a.max_hp!=null)ch.maxHp=Math.max(1,a.max_hp);if(a.hp!=null)ch.hp=Math.max(0,Math.min(ch.maxHp,a.hp));if(a.armor_class!=null)ch.ac=Math.max(1,a.armor_class);if(a.level!=null)ch.level=Math.max(1,a.level);ch.mechanicsReady=true;addEvent('mechanics',`${ch.name}: ${a.reason}`,{actor:'DM',actorId:null,location:ch.location});save();render()}}else if(name==='render_card'){state.cards.push({...a,id:uid('card')});toolCards.push({kind:'card',...a});renderTools()}else if(name==='propose_state_patch'){toolCards.push({kind:'patch',...a});renderTools()}else if(name==='set_atmosphere'){if(state.ui.dmThemeControl){state.atmosphere={theme:a.theme,effects:(a.effects||[]).filter(x=>x!=='none'),intensity:a.intensity,reason:a.reason,transition_ms:a.transition_ms};applyAtmosphere(state.atmosphere);addEvent('atmosphere',`Atmosphere shifted: ${THEMES[a.theme]?.name||a.theme}`,{actor:'DM',actorId:null});save();render()}else toast(`DM suggested ${THEMES[a.theme]?.name||a.theme}; visual control is off`)}else if(name==='suggest_visual_prompt'){state.visualPrompts.push({id:uid('prompt'),kind:a.kind,title:a.title,prompt:a.prompt,aspect:a.suggested_aspect_ratio,at:nowISO()});addEvent('visual',`DM suggested art: ${a.title}`,{actor:'DM',actorId:null});save();render()}}
function renderTools(){$('toolShelf').innerHTML=toolCards.map((t,i)=>t.kind==='roll'?`<div class="tool-card"><div class="eyebrow">Roll requested</div><h4>${esc(t.label)}</h4><p>${esc(t.reason)} · ${esc(t.ability)} DC ${t.dc}</p><button class="button primary compact" data-tool-roll="${i}">Roll d20</button></div>`:t.kind==='patch'?`<div class="tool-card"><div class="eyebrow">State change</div><h4>${esc(t.reason)}</h4><p>${esc([t.scene_title,t.quest_title,t.loot_name].filter(Boolean).join(' · '))}</p><button class="button compact" data-patch="${i}">Apply</button></div>`:`<div class="tool-card"><div class="eyebrow">${esc(t.card_type)}</div><h4>${esc(t.title)}</h4><p>${esc(t.subtitle)}</p><div class="markdown">${markdown(t.markdown)}</div></div>`).join('');$$('[data-tool-roll]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>performRoll(toolCards[+b.dataset.toolRoll]));$$('[data-patch]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>applyPatch(toolCards[+b.dataset.patch]))}
function applyPatch(p){if(p.scene_title){state.scene.title=p.scene_title;state.scene.location=p.scene_title}if(p.scene_description)state.scene.text=p.scene_description;if(p.journal_append)state.journal+=(state.journal?'\n\n':'')+p.journal_append;if(p.hp_delta!=null){const target=p.character_name&&state.characters.find(c=>(c.name||'').toLowerCase()===String(p.character_name).toLowerCase());if(target&&target.maxHp!=null&&target.hp!=null){target.hp=Math.max(0,Math.min(target.maxHp,target.hp+p.hp_delta));target.mechanicsReady=true}else toast('DM state change did not name a character with established HP; HP was not changed.')}if(p.quest_title){const q=state.quests.find(q=>q.title===p.quest_title);q?q.note=p.quest_note:state.quests.push({title:p.quest_title,note:p.quest_note||''})}if(p.loot_name)state.inventory.push({name:p.loot_name,description:p.loot_description||''});addEvent('state',p.reason,{actor:'DM',actorId:null});save();render();toast('Campaign updated')}
function rollDie(sides,label=`d${sides}`){const value=1+Math.floor(Math.random()*sides);addEvent('roll',`${label}: ${value}`);state.messages.push({id:uid('msg'),who:state.localPlayer.name,kind:'player',text:`🎲 ${label}: **${value}**`,at:nowISO()});save();render();toast(`${label}: ${value}`);return value}

Continue from that result.`),80)}
