// WebRTC host-star multiplayer ---------------------------------------------------
const PEER_DISCONNECT_GRACE_MS=30000;
const rtc={
  role:'solo',ws:null,room:'',peers:{},pc:null,dc:null,
  iceServers:[{urls:['stun:stun.cloudflare.com:3478']}],connected:false,retry:null,retryAttempt:0,serviceDown:false,hostUnavailable:false,joinError:'',pendingIce:{},presenceTimers:{},disconnectTimers:{},localCharacterDraft:null,
  async loadIce(){try{const d=await getJSON('/api/ice');this.iceServers=d.iceServers||this.iceServers}catch{}},
  async startHost(room){
    this.leave(false);await this.loadIce();this.role='host';this.room=room;this.hostUnavailable=false;
    state.multiplayer.role='host';state.multiplayer.lastRoom=room;save({broadcast:false});this.connectSignal();render();toast(`Hosting ${room}`)
  },
  async join(room){
    this.localCharacterDraft=clone(currentCharacter());this.leave(false);await this.loadIce();this.role='player';this.room=room.toUpperCase();this.hostUnavailable=false;this.joinError='';
    state.multiplayer.role='player';state.multiplayer.lastRoom=this.room;save({broadcast:false});this.connectSignal();render()
  },
  async connectSignal(){
    if(!appConfig.signaling||this.role==='solo'||[0,1].includes(this.ws?.readyState))return;
    if(appConfig.signaling_healthy===false){
      try{const fresh=await getJSON('/api/config');appConfig={...appConfig,...fresh}}catch{}
      if(appConfig.signaling_healthy===false){this.serviceDown=true;renderJoinOverlay();clearTimeout(this.retry);this.retry=setTimeout(()=>this.connectSignal(),5000);return}
    }
    const scheme=location.protocol==='https:'?'wss':'ws';
    const ws=new WebSocket(`${scheme}://${location.host}/ws/room/${encodeURIComponent(this.room)}/${encodeURIComponent(state.localPlayer.id)}?role=${this.role}`);
    this.ws=ws;
    ws.onopen=()=>{this.connected=true;this.serviceDown=false;this.hostUnavailable=false;this.retryAttempt=0;appConfig.signaling_healthy=true;renderNetworkStatus();renderJoinOverlay();if(this.role==='player')this.signal('*','hello',{name:state.localPlayer.name,character:(this.localCharacterDraft||currentCharacter()).name})};
    ws.onmessage=async e=>{try{await this.onSignal(JSON.parse(e.data))}catch(err){console.error('Could not handle multiplayer signal',err)}};
    ws.onclose=e=>{
      this.connected=false;renderNetworkStatus();renderJoinOverlay();
      if(this.role!=='solo'&&e.code!==1000){clearTimeout(this.retry);this.retryAttempt=Math.min(this.retryAttempt+1,6);const wait=this.hostUnavailable?15000:Math.min(15000,900*Math.pow(1.8,this.retryAttempt))+Math.random()*500;this.retry=setTimeout(()=>this.connectSignal(),wait)}
    }
  },
  signal(target,type,payload){if(this.ws?.readyState===1)this.ws.send(JSON.stringify({type,target,payload:{kind:type,...payload}}))},
  async onSignal(msg){
    if(msg.type==='server_draining'){setTimeout(()=>{try{this.ws?.close(1012,'reconnect')}catch{}},120);return}
    if(msg.type==='service_unavailable'){this.serviceDown=true;appConfig.signaling_healthy=false;renderJoinOverlay();return}
    if(msg.type==='host_offline'){
      console.warn('Signaling server reports host offline for room',this.room);
      const first=!this.hostUnavailable;this.hostUnavailable=true;this.connected=false;state.multiplayer.hostOnline=false;renderNetworkStatus();renderJoinOverlay();
      if(first)toast('Host is offline — campaign stays read-only until they return');return
    }
    if(msg.type==='presence'){
      clearTimeout(this.presenceTimers[msg.sender]);
      if(msg.event==='joined'&&this.role==='host'&&msg.role==='player'){
        if(['failed','closed'].includes(this.peers[msg.sender]?.pc.connectionState))this.closePeer(msg.sender);
        setTimeout(()=>this.makeOffer(msg.sender),120);
      }
      if(msg.event==='left')this.presenceTimers[msg.sender]=setTimeout(()=>{const pc=this.peers[msg.sender]?.pc;if(pc?.connectionState!=='connected')this.closePeer(msg.sender)},PEER_DISCONNECT_GRACE_MS);
      renderPresence();renderNetworkStatus();return
    }
    const p=msg.payload||{};
    if(p.kind==='hello'&&this.role==='host')await this.makeOffer(msg.sender,p);
    else if(p.kind==='offer'&&this.role==='player')await this.acceptOffer(msg.sender,p);
    else if(p.kind==='answer'&&this.role==='host'){
      const peer=this.peers[msg.sender];
      if(!peer)return;
      if(peer.pc.signalingState!=='have-local-offer'||peer.applyingAnswer){
        console.warn('Ignoring duplicate or stale WebRTC answer',{peer:msg.sender,signalingState:peer.pc.signalingState,applyingAnswer:!!peer.applyingAnswer});
        return
      }
      peer.applyingAnswer=true;
      try{await peer.pc.setRemoteDescription(p.sdp);await this.flushIce(msg.sender,peer.pc)}
      finally{peer.applyingAnswer=false}
    }
    else if(p.kind==='ice'&&p.candidate)await this.receiveIce(msg.sender,p.candidate)
  },
  async makeOffer(peerId,hello={}){
    if(this.peers[peerId])return;
    const pc=new RTCPeerConnection({iceServers:this.iceServers}),dc=pc.createDataChannel('lantern',{ordered:true});
    this.peers[peerId]={pc,dc,name:hello.name||'Player',character:hello.character||'',role:'player'};this.setupPC(pc,peerId);this.setupDC(dc,peerId);
    const offer=await pc.createOffer();await pc.setLocalDescription(offer);this.signal(peerId,'offer',{sdp:pc.localDescription})
  },
  async acceptOffer(hostId,p){
    if(this.acceptingOffer||(this.pc&&this.pc.signalingState!=='closed')){
      console.warn('Ignoring duplicate WebRTC offer',{host:hostId,signalingState:this.pc.signalingState});
      return
    }
    this.acceptingOffer=true;
    const pc=new RTCPeerConnection({iceServers:this.iceServers});this.pc=pc;this.setupPC(pc,hostId);pc.ondatachannel=e=>{this.dc=e.channel;this.setupDC(this.dc,hostId)};
    try{await pc.setRemoteDescription(p.sdp);await this.flushIce(hostId,pc);const ans=await pc.createAnswer();await pc.setLocalDescription(ans);this.signal(hostId,'answer',{sdp:pc.localDescription})}
    finally{this.acceptingOffer=false}
  },
  async receiveIce(peerId,candidate){
    const pc=this.role==='host'?this.peers[peerId]?.pc:this.pc;
    if(!pc||!pc.remoteDescription){(this.pendingIce[peerId] ||= []).push(candidate);return}
    try{await pc.addIceCandidate(candidate)}catch(err){console.warn('Could not add WebRTC candidate',err)}
  },
  async flushIce(peerId,pc){
    const candidates=this.pendingIce[peerId]||[];delete this.pendingIce[peerId];
    for(const candidate of candidates){try{await pc.addIceCandidate(candidate)}catch(err){console.warn('Could not add queued WebRTC candidate',err)}}
  },
  async reportPeerDiagnostic(pc,peerId,event,includePair=false){
    const data={event,connectionState:pc.connectionState,iceConnectionState:pc.iceConnectionState,iceGatheringState:pc.iceGatheringState,signalingState:pc.signalingState,candidateTypes:[...(pc.lanternCandidateTypes||[])]};
    if(includePair){
      try{
        const stats=await pc.getStats(),pairs=[...stats.values()].filter(s=>s.type==='candidate-pair');
        const pair=pairs.find(s=>s.selected)||pairs.find(s=>s.nominated&&s.state==='succeeded')||pairs.find(s=>s.state==='failed')||pairs.find(s=>s.state==='in-progress');
        if(pair){const local=stats.get(pair.localCandidateId),remote=stats.get(pair.remoteCandidateId);data.candidatePair={state:pair.state,localType:local?.candidateType,remoteType:remote?.candidateType,protocol:local?.protocol||remote?.protocol,relayProtocol:local?.relayProtocol||remote?.relayProtocol}}
      }catch(err){console.warn('Could not collect WebRTC diagnostic stats',err)}
    }
    this.signal('*','diagnostic',data)
  },
  setupPC(pc,peerId){
    pc.lanternCandidateTypes=new Set();
    pc.onicecandidate=e=>{if(e.candidate){if(e.candidate.type)pc.lanternCandidateTypes.add(e.candidate.type);this.signal(peerId,'ice',{candidate:e.candidate})}else this.reportPeerDiagnostic(pc,peerId,'ice-gathering-complete')};
    pc.onicegatheringstatechange=()=>this.reportPeerDiagnostic(pc,peerId,'ice-gathering-state');
    pc.onsignalingstatechange=()=>this.reportPeerDiagnostic(pc,peerId,'signaling-state');
    pc.oniceconnectionstatechange=()=>this.reportPeerDiagnostic(pc,peerId,'ice-connection-state',true);
    if(this.role==='player')setTimeout(()=>{if(this.pc===pc&&this.dc?.readyState!=='open'&&!this.joinError){this.reportPeerDiagnostic(pc,peerId,'join-timeout',true);this.joinError='The host was found, but the devices could not establish a direct connection. The network may require TURN relay support.';renderJoinOverlay()}},20000);
    pc.onconnectionstatechange=()=>{
      this.reportPeerDiagnostic(pc,peerId,'connection-state',pc.connectionState!=='connected');
      clearTimeout(this.disconnectTimers[peerId]);
      if(pc.connectionState==='connected'){
        if(this.role==='player'){this.connected=true;state.multiplayer.hostOnline=true;renderNetworkStatus()}
        return
      }
      if(pc.connectionState==='disconnected'){
        if(this.role==='player'){this.connected=false;state.multiplayer.hostOnline=false;renderNetworkStatus()}
        else this.disconnectTimers[peerId]=setTimeout(()=>{if(pc.connectionState==='disconnected')this.closePeer(peerId)},PEER_DISCONNECT_GRACE_MS);
        return
      }
      if(pc.connectionState==='failed'||pc.connectionState==='closed'){
        if(this.role==='player'){
          this.connected=false;state.multiplayer.hostOnline=false;
          if(pc.connectionState==='failed'){this.joinError='The host was found, but the devices could not establish a direct connection. The network may require TURN relay support.';renderJoinOverlay()}
          renderNetworkStatus()
        }else this.closePeer(peerId)
      }
    }
  },
  setupDC(dc,peerId){
    dc.onopen=()=>{
      const pc=this.role==='host'?this.peers[peerId]?.pc:this.pc;if(pc)this.reportPeerDiagnostic(pc,peerId,'data-channel-open');
      this.connected=true;this.hostUnavailable=false;this.serviceDown=false;state.multiplayer.hostOnline=true;
      if(this.role==='host'){
        const p=this.peers[peerId];dc.send(JSON.stringify({type:'snapshot',state:sanitizedState()}));dc.send(JSON.stringify({type:'peer_info',name:state.localPlayer.name,character:currentCharacter().name}));if(p)toast(`${p.name||'A player'} joined the table`)
      }else{
        dc.send(JSON.stringify({type:'peer_info',name:state.localPlayer.name,character:(this.localCharacterDraft||currentCharacter()).name}));toast('Connected to host')
      }
      render()
    };
    dc.onmessage=e=>{try{this.onData(JSON.parse(e.data),peerId)}catch(err){console.error(err)}};
    dc.onclose=()=>{const pc=this.role==='host'?this.peers[peerId]?.pc:this.pc;if(pc)this.reportPeerDiagnostic(pc,peerId,'data-channel-close',true);if(this.role==='player'){this.connected=false;state.multiplayer.hostOnline=false;renderNetworkStatus();renderJoinOverlay()}else this.closePeer(peerId)}
  },
  onData(m,peerId){
    if(this.role==='host'){
      if(m.type==='peer_info'){Object.assign(this.peers[peerId]||{},m);renderPresence()}
      else if(m.type==='player_action'){const peer=this.peers[peerId]||{};if(!dmAborter)act(m.text,{remoteActor:{name:m.actor||peer.name||'Player',id:peerId}})}
      else if(m.type==='character_claim'&&m.playerId===peerId){
        let ch=state.characters.find(c=>c.ownerPlayerId===peerId);
        if(!ch){
          const src=m.character&&typeof m.character==='object'?m.character:{};
          ch=createRandomCharacter({id:uid('char'),ownerPlayerId:peerId,location:state.scene.location,nameExclusions:state.characters.map(c=>c.name),notes:typeof src.notes==='string'?src.notes.slice(0,4000):''});
          state.characters.push(ch);
          const peer=this.peers[peerId];if(peer){peer.character=ch.name;peer.dc?.send(JSON.stringify({type:'character_claimed',character:ch}))}
          addEvent('character',`${ch.name} joined the party`,{actor:ch.name,actorId:peerId,location:ch.location});save();render()
        }
      }
      else if(m.type==='character_patch'&&m.playerId===peerId){
        const ch=state.characters.find(c=>c.ownerPlayerId===peerId),patch=m.patch&&typeof m.patch==='object'?m.patch:{};
        if(ch&&state.campaign.permissions.playersEditOwnCharacter){
          let changed=false;
          if(typeof patch.name==='string'){
            const proposedName=patch.name.trim().slice(0,80);
            const nameTaken=state.characters.some(other=>other!==ch&&String(other.name||'').trim().toLocaleLowerCase()===proposedName.toLocaleLowerCase());
            const name=proposedName?(nameTaken?randomCharacterName(state.characters.filter(other=>other!==ch).map(other=>other.name)):proposedName):ch.name;
            if(name!==ch.name){ch.name=name;changed=true}
          }
          if(typeof patch.notes==='string'&&patch.notes!==ch.notes){ch.notes=patch.notes.slice(0,4000);changed=true}
          if(changed){addEvent('character',`${ch.name} updated their character`,{actor:ch.name,actorId:peerId,location:ch.location});save();render()}
        }
      }
    }else{
      if(m.type==='snapshot'){
        const draft=clone(this.localCharacterDraft||currentCharacter());const localPrefs={ui:state.ui,audio:state.audio,localPlayer:state.localPlayer,multiplayer:state.multiplayer};
        state=mergeDefaults(defaults,m.state);Object.assign(state,localPrefs);state.multiplayer.role='player';state.multiplayer.hostOnline=true;
        let owned=state.characters.find(c=>c.ownerPlayerId===state.localPlayer.id);
        if(!owned){owned={...clone(CHARACTER_DEFAULTS),id:uid('char'),ownerPlayerId:state.localPlayer.id,name:'Creating adventurer…',location:state.scene.location,creationVersion:0};state.characters.push(owned);this.sendHost({type:'character_claim',playerId:state.localPlayer.id,character:{notes:draft.notes}})}
         else if(draft&&state.campaign.permissions.playersEditOwnCharacter){const patch={name:draft.name,notes:draft.notes};Object.assign(owned,patch);this.sendHost({type:'character_patch',playerId:state.localPlayer.id,patch})}
        state.localPlayer.characterId=owned.id;this.localCharacterDraft=clone(owned);joinIntent='';history.replaceState(null,'',location.pathname+location.search);save({broadcast:false});render()
      }
      else if(m.type==='character_claimed'){
        const owned=state.characters.find(c=>c.ownerPlayerId===state.localPlayer.id);
        if(owned&&m.character?.ownerPlayerId===state.localPlayer.id){Object.assign(owned,normalizeCharacter(m.character));this.localCharacterDraft=clone(owned);render()}
      }
      else if(m.type==='player_action_echo'){state.messages.push({id:uid('msg'),who:m.actor||'Player',kind:'player',text:m.text||'',at:nowISO()});addEvent('action',m.text||'',{actor:m.actor||'Player',actorId:null});save({broadcast:false});render()}
      else if(m.type==='dm_delta'){if(!streamMessage)streamMessage={text:''};streamMessage.text+=m.delta;narrator.feed(m.delta);queueTranscriptRender()}
      else if(m.type==='dm_done'){streamMessage=null;state.messages.push({id:uid('msg'),who:'DM',kind:'dm',text:m.text,at:nowISO()});narrator.flush();save({broadcast:false});render()}
      else if(m.type==='dm_tool')handleTool(m.name,m.args)
      else if(m.type==='peer_info'){this.peers[peerId]={name:m.name,character:m.character,role:'host'};renderPresence()}
    }
  },
  broadcast(m){if(this.role!=='host')return;for(const p of Object.values(this.peers))if(p.dc?.readyState==='open')p.dc.send(JSON.stringify(m))},
  sendHost(m){if(this.role==='player'&&this.dc?.readyState==='open'){this.dc.send(JSON.stringify(m));return true}return false},
  closePeer(id){const p=this.peers[id];clearTimeout(this.presenceTimers[id]);clearTimeout(this.disconnectTimers[id]);delete this.presenceTimers[id];delete this.disconnectTimers[id];if(p){delete this.peers[id];try{p.pc.close()}catch{}}renderPresence()},
  leave(update=true){clearTimeout(this.retry);Object.values(this.presenceTimers).forEach(clearTimeout);Object.values(this.disconnectTimers).forEach(clearTimeout);try{this.ws?.close(1000)}catch{}try{this.pc?.close()}catch{}for(const p of Object.values(this.peers))try{p.pc.close()}catch{}this.ws=null;this.pc=null;this.dc=null;this.peers={};this.pendingIce={};this.presenceTimers={};this.disconnectTimers={};this.role='solo';this.connected=false;this.hostUnavailable=false;this.joinError='';if(update){state.multiplayer.role='solo';save({broadcast:false});render()}}
};
function openJoinPrompt(){const code=prompt('Join code',state.multiplayer.lastRoom||'');if(code){joinIntent=code.trim().toUpperCase();rtc.join(joinIntent)}}
function renderJoinOverlay(){const el=$('joinOverlay');if(!joinIntent||rtc.role!=='player'||rtc.dc?.readyState==='open'){el.classList.add('hidden');return}el.classList.remove('hidden');$('joinOverlayCode').textContent=joinIntent;const retry=$('joinRetry');if(rtc.joinError){$('joinOverlayTitle').textContent='Direct connection failed';$('joinOverlayText').textContent=rtc.joinError;retry.classList.remove('hidden')}else if(rtc.serviceDown){$('joinOverlayTitle').textContent='Table service is restarting';$('joinOverlayText').textContent='Your invite is valid. Signaling is temporarily unavailable; Lantern Table will retry automatically.';retry.classList.remove('hidden')}else if(rtc.hostUnavailable){$('joinOverlayTitle').textContent='Host is offline';$('joinOverlayText').textContent='This campaign cannot progress until its host opens the table again.';retry.classList.remove('hidden')}else{$('joinOverlayTitle').textContent='Finding the host…';$('joinOverlayText').textContent='Connecting directly to the existing campaign. You will not create a new table.';retry.classList.add('hidden')}}

function modifierLabel(value){return value>=0?`+${value}`:String(value)}

# Lantern Table Kubernetes deployment

This directory is tuned for the current WaylonWalker homelab conventions.

- namespace: `lantern-table`
- image: `registry.wayl.one/lantern-table:latest` (pin a release/Git SHA in Argo)
- existing image pull secret: `cluster-regcred`
- ingress class: `traefik`
- cert-manager issuer: `letsencrypt-dns`
- hostname: `dnd.waylonwalker.com`
- app replicas: 2
- signaling bus: ephemeral Valkey, persistence disabled

The service stores no campaign data. Valkey carries only temporary signaling presence/pubsub.

## Argo rollout behavior

The app Deployment uses a rolling strategy with `maxUnavailable: 0` and `maxSurge: 1`. Before termination, a pod marks itself draining so readiness fails and connected signaling browsers reconnect. Active WebRTC DataChannels continue independently of the signaling pod.

The old and new pod may overlap safely because room signaling routes through Valkey. Connection markers prevent an old pod from deleting a host presence key after that same browser has already reconnected to a new pod.

## TURN

Cloudflare STUN is always returned. TURN is optional and is only needed when peers cannot establish a direct path.

Do not commit `turn-secret.example.yaml` with real credentials. Prefer:

```bash
CLOUDFLARE_TURN_KEY_ID=... \
CLOUDFLARE_TURN_API_TOKEN=... \
just turn-secret
```

## GitOps

`just deploy` is for direct testing. Once this directory is copied into `homelab-argo`, publish the image, pin the tag in Git, and let Argo synchronize instead of mutating the Deployment imperatively.



================================================
FILE: k8s/deployment.yaml
================================================
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: lantern-table
  namespace: lantern-table
spec:
  replicas: 2
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxUnavailable: 0
      maxSurge: 1
  minReadySeconds: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: lantern-table
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: lantern-table
    spec:
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 90
      imagePullSecrets:
        - name: cluster-regcred
      securityContext:
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      affinity:
        podAntiAffinity:
          preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
            - weight: 80
              podAffinityTerm:
                labelSelector:
                  matchLabels:
                    app: lantern-table
                topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: registry.wayl.one/lantern-table:latest
          imagePullPolicy: Always
          env:
            - name: LANTERN_MODE
              value: public
            - name: LANTERN_BIND
              value: 0.0.0.0
            - name: LANTERN_PORT
              value: "8765"
            - name: LANTERN_PUBLIC_ORIGIN
              value: https://dnd.waylonwalker.com
            - name: LANTERN_COMPANION_ORIGIN
              value: http://127.0.0.1:8765
            - name: REDIS_URL
              value: redis://lantern-valkey:6379/0
          envFrom:
            - secretRef:
                name: lantern-table-turn
                optional: true
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 8765
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /health/ready
              port: http
            initialDelaySeconds: 2
            periodSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 2
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /health/live
              port: http
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            periodSeconds: 20
          lifecycle:
            preStop:
              exec:
                command:
                  - python
                  - -c
                  - |
                    import time, urllib.request
                    try:
                        urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request('http://127.0.0.1:8765/internal/drain', method='POST'), timeout=2).read()
                    except Exception:
                        pass
                    time.sleep(5)
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 25m
              memory: 72Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 750m
              memory: 320Mi
          securityContext:
            runAsNonRoot: true
            runAsUser: 1000
            runAsGroup: 1000
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          volumeMounts:
            - name: tmp
              mountPath: /tmp
            - name: config
              mountPath: /home/lantern/.config
      volumes:
        - name: tmp
          emptyDir: {}
        - name: config
          emptyDir: {}

apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: lantern-table
  namespace: lantern-table
  annotations:
    cert-manager.io/cluster-issuer: letsencrypt-dns
spec:
  ingressClassName: traefik
  rules:
    - host: dnd.waylonwalker.com
      http:
        paths:
          - path: /
            pathType: Prefix
            backend:
              service:
                name: lantern-table
                port:
                  number: 8765
  tls:
    - hosts:
        - dnd.waylonwalker.com
      secretName: dnd-waylonwalker-com-tls

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: lantern-valkey
  namespace: lantern-table
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: lantern-valkey
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: lantern-valkey
    spec:
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      securityContext:
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: valkey
          image: valkey/valkey:8.1-alpine
          args: ["--save", "", "--appendonly", "no", "--protected-mode", "no"]
          ports:
            - name: redis
              containerPort: 6379
          readinessProbe:
            exec:
              command: ["valkey-cli", "ping"]
            initialDelaySeconds: 2
            periodSeconds: 5
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 10m
              memory: 24Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 150m
              memory: 96Mi
          securityContext:
            runAsNonRoot: true
            runAsUser: 999
            runAsGroup: 999
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          volumeMounts:
            - name: data
              mountPath: /data
      volumes:
        - name: data
          emptyDir: {}
